name: Horstmar (Germany)
description: Banner of the city arms of Horstmar: white with a red lion in the upper hoist and blue horizontal bars, two across the lower part and two shorter ones in the upper fly.
history: Municipal flag of Horstmar; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: two blue bars across the lower part
two shorter blue bars in the upper fly
